title: LAMPS THROW BODY SHADOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. Bodies only ever had a soft blob under their feet. At LIGHTING HIGH anyone standing in a lamp pool (you, your teammates, and the machines and pillagers you can see) now also throws a shadow along the ground away from the lamp: short and dark close to it, long and faint at the edge of the pool, up to two shadows from the two brightest lamps. A lamp behind a wall throws none. Bodies you cannot see throw no shadow, so nothing gives away a hidden enemy. STANDARD and CLASSIC are unchanged.
now: At LIGHTING HIGH you, your team and every machine you can see now throw shadows away from the lamps around you.

edits.anchor: function gfxShadowPass(dt){ return gfxHook('shadow'); }   // B: body shadows that follow the lamps
